_comment: Awin feeds used by Sporty Gear World. advertiserId is the Awin advertiser id (file names AWIN_<advertiserId>_<feedId>.csv.gz in the Awin archive folders). Without feedIds, every file of that retailer is read. Add a retailer only after Awin has approved the programme. allowPaths (lessons L65): only products from these sport sections of the shop's category path come in, never a tool or tech shop's product because its name has a sport word. First version (25 Oct 2026, after the sports feed scan): Coes, Joybuy UK, Plusshop UK, Bazta UK (the same catalogue at two prices, lessons L40) and Beyond Shakers. Bern Helmets (bike, snow and skate helmets; joined 31 Oct 2026; its youth helmets go to Kids' Gear World by the kids rule). VEVOR NL comes in a second wave (owner, 25 Oct 2026). sectionHints false (plan, 25 Oct 2026): the shop's own sub-section never picks the category (Coes puts every sport product under the Awin category 'Fitness'; Joybuy's sub-sections are often wrong), only the product name does. retailer is the name shown on the site.
